biggest_gap.title: Custom fields are second-class in the global audit log: they cannot be chosen in the Fields filter, and every custom-field change also appears as a raw row named by the field's key with stored option codes
biggest_gap.detail: The spec asks for complete capture including custom fields, and for a log filtered by user, record type, record, field and date. A contact's own history and its Contact row in the log are correct: 'شريحة العميل: من حكومي إلى موزع' / 'Customer segment: from Government to Distributor'. The global log falls short on custom fields in three ways. (1) Its Fields filter offers 187 choices in English and 186 in Arabic. None is a tenant custom field (Customer segment, Credit review date, Account manager, Preferred partner); the only custom-looking choices are the storage columns 'Text value', 'Number value' and 'Default value'. The API also refuses the field key the Contact row itself carries: filter=fields eq 'custom_fields.cfCustomerSegment' answers 400 list.valueChoice. So 'who changed the Customer segment of any contact' cannot be asked of the log. (2) Each custom-field change makes a second row of kind 'Custom field value', with Record 'cfCustomerSegment' (the key) and Field 'Text value' / 'القيمة النصية'. Its values are the stored option codes: 'Text value: from government to distributor', 'القيمة النصية: من government إلى distributor'. This holds in both languages, and the demo has 240,225 such rows. (3) A new value reads 'الحقل الرمز: cfCreditReview؛ الحقل قيمة التاريخ: ...' in Arabic. For a UAE trader whose own fields (segment, credit review, account manager) are exactly what an auditor asks about, the log shows codes and cannot be narrowed to the field. Fix: resolve customfields.field_values rows to the owning record and the field's label and option labels, or hide them where the owning record's row already carries the change. Offer the tenant's custom fields (custom_fields.<code>) in the Fields filter and accept them in the API filter.
biggest_gap.evidence: Reproduce on ./erp up with ERP_SEED_*_CSV, signed in as admin.ar@alnoor.example. Open a contact by Ctrl+K, change Customer segment by keyboard and press Ctrl+S (browser/edit.mjs ar, edit-ar.out). Then press G L, open the 'بواسطة' column options, choose Filter, type 'فاطمة الزعابي' and press Enter twice (browser/picker.mjs). Screenshot ar-06-log-by-person.jpg shows the row 'قيمة حقل مخ... | cfCustomerSegment | القيمة النصية | القيمة النصية: من government إلى distributor' beside the correct Contact row. API: attack/cfrow2.mjs, cfrow.out (ar) and cfrow-en.out (en) give record 'cfCustomerSegment' and changes 'Text value: from government to distributor'. attack/cffilter.mjs: fields eq 'custom_fields.cfCustomerSegment' gives 400 and fields eq 'text_value' gives 200 with 200,013 rows. browser/fieldopts.mjs en|ar: '187 choices, custom-looking: ["Text value"]'.

other_findings: A server error in p07's people search. GET /api/audit/actors?search= with any character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (an emoji, e.g. 'Ali 😀') answers 500. System.Text.EncoderFallbackException: NameMatch.Pattern escapes each half of a surrogate pair separately, so Npgsql gets a lone surrogate (IdentityModule.cs:468 via AuditEndpoints.cs:134). Repro: attack/actors-r8.mjs and emoji.mjs (both languages give 500 with a trace id).

[route: p05-list-search] The same emoji search gives 500 on GET /api/audit/log?search=, /api/identity/users?search= and /api/contacts/contacts?search=. EncoderFallbackException 'at index 2' is thrown in Erp.Kernel.Lists.ListBinding`1.QueryAsync, the shared list search (attack/emoji.out).
